description: Check domain availability and pricing: for each requested domain, whether it can be registered now, the registration and renewal price for one full term, and a checkout URL for available names.

domains.description: 1-200 fully-qualified domain names, each including its TLD (e.g. ["acme.com", "acme.io"]). The tool checks exactly these names. Preferred over query.

query.description: Free text: one or more names, comma- or space-separated. Names given without a TLD are expanded to com/io/ai/co/net. Ignored when domains is supplied.

name: search_domains
